en.headline: Worker dies after fall at Tung Chung construction site
en.dek: Police said a 30-year-old man fell onto a platform at a Wui Tung Street site on Wednesday afternoon and was later certified dead at North Lantau Hospital.
body: A construction worker died on Wednesday afternoon after falling from a height at a site on Wui Tung Street in Tung Chung, police said.

Officers received a report at about 1pm that a 30-year-old man working on the site near Ying Tung Estate had fallen onto a platform and was unconscious. Rescuers took him to North Lantau Hospital. RTHK reported that he was certified dead at about 2.30pm.
Police are treating the case as an industrial accident. The cause of the fall was still under investigation, and no further casualties were reported.

zh.headline: 東涌匯東街地盤工人高處墮下 送院後不治
zh.dek: 警方稱一名30歲男工周三下午在匯東街地盤墮下至平台，送北大嶼山醫院搶救，約下午2時半證實死亡。
body: 東涌匯東街一個建築地盤周三下午發生致命工業意外，一名工人從高處墮下，送院後不治。
警方下午1時許接報，指匯東街近翔東邨一個地盤內，一名30歲男工在高處工作期間墮下至平台，陷入昏迷。救援人員到場後將他送往北大嶼山醫院，香港電台報道指他延至下午約2時半證實死亡。
警方正調查意外起因，案件列作工業意外。現場沒有再接報其他傷者。
